title: LegalStatusChanged.v1
description: Payload of the LegalStatusChanged event (A§23). Emitted by legal-service — the single producer (A§7.2) — once per transition of a legal case, including the first transition into OPEN (A§5.13, D§13). Published on `collections.legal` keyed by `legalCaseId` (A§23/§25), so the whole legal history of one case is strictly ordered and the append-only status history can be rebuilt from the topic (D§3.6). Legal recovery is deliberately a separate bounded capability integrated through events, never legal workflow embedded in case-service (D§13). Load-bearing for invariant A§11.6: agency-service maintains its read model from this event and rejects a placement while legal ownership is active, the mirror of legal-service's own referral guard. Referral-level transitions (REQUESTED -> ACCEPTED|REJECTED) are internal to legal-service and are not published here: this event is about the legal case, which only exists once a referral has been accepted. Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as LegalStatusChanged.v2 (D§29).

legalCaseId.description: Platform identifier of the legal case. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§23).

accountId.description: Platform identifier of the account under legal recovery — the key on which the A§11.6 agency/legal mutual exclusion is evaluated in both directions.

caseId.description: Platform identifier of the collection case the legal recovery escalates from (A§10.1 ESCALATED -> LEGAL), so the transition lands as a case activity on the right case.

fromStatus.description: Legal case status before this transition, or null for the first transition — the creation of the legal case, which has no predecessor. Structurally always present, so required and nullable rather than optional. Same closed vocabulary as `toStatus`.

toStatus.description: Legal case status reached by this transition. Closed enum, exactly the legal case machine OPEN -> IN_PROCEEDINGS -> JUDGMENT -> ENFORCEMENT -> CLOSED (SVC-10): the states are the normative lifecycle, transitions are explicit and audited, and adding one is a domain change rather than an additive contract change. Any status other than CLOSED means legal ownership is active, which blocks agency placement (A§11.6).

reason.description: Why the status changed, or null when the transition is the unremarkable next step of the process and no reason was recorded. Open SCREAMING_SNAKE vocabulary: legal reasons are jurisdiction-specific and cannot be enumerated centrally. Structurally always present, so required and nullable.
